useful_delta: Defined a campaign-level architecture that keeps Project North, Campaign and Run as separate identities; makes campaign control an orthogonal durable state machine with evidence gates, adaptive depth, parallel scheduling, checkpoints and reincarnation; and maps it onto existing Chat Object, Planner, Agent Network, Work Item/Run/RETURN, Steward and authority infrastructure instead of rebuilding those systems.
facts: The binding Big Picture explicitly separates CONSTITUTION -> ACTIVE_METHOD -> PRODUCT_MEMORY -> PROJECT_NORTH -> CAMPAIGN -> RUN and defines Project North as durable direction, Campaign as a bounded multi-day/multi-chat effort, and Run as one model/chat/worker execution.

The binding Big Picture says campaign state must include objective, plan/map, counters/gates, current phase, Working Set, prepared jobs, returns, open conflicts, evidence, checkpoints, target head/working head and successor state.

The binding Big Picture assigns campaign phase transitions, gates, adaptive depth, worker timing, critic timing, compaction, integration, checkpoints and human escalation to a durable Campaign Controller.

The Survival Set requires the human not to be scheduler/collector/comparator/integrator/context bus; jobs must exist before workers; STARTED/RETURN/DONE are durable evidence; parent batch state is derived rather than remembered.

Current Chat Object and FOCUS records mention campaign as a required layer but do not provide a separate durable campaign identity/state object; current orchestration is still represented mainly in Chat Object FOCUS + Work Board.

Existing worker fabric already provides durable JOB -> independent Run -> RETURN -> parent/steward integration and should remain the execution layer below Campaign rather than being replaced by a new scheduler.

Capture -> Planner handoff already demonstrates a useful reusable pattern for campaign boundaries: immutable snapshot identity, revision/watermark/digest integrity, explicit barrier, idempotence and no silent advance on incomplete inputs.

Current GitHub code/search and commit archaeology did not reopen standalone historical definitions for WAITING_DOT, DAY_WORK, R38 4X or Campaign Metabolism. Their existence/importance is preserved by the current Big Picture, but detailed semantics below are therefore candidate mappings, not recovered historical fact.

project_north.role: Long-lived human/product direction and durable success constraints above any one campaign.
project_north.identity: project_id plus explicit Project North ref/version; not a Chat Object, workstream or campaign.
project_north.mutation_rule: Campaigns may propose north-star changes but must not silently rewrite Project North. Human-accepted direction remains separately authoritative.

campaign.role: Bounded multi-phase effort that can outlive chats/models and coordinate many Work Items/Runs.
campaign.identity: campaign_id, stable across chat reincarnations and worker batches.
campaign.authority_rule: Campaign state coordinates work and evidence; it does not itself create Human Accepted, Current or Served truth.

run.role: One disposable execution of one prepared Work Item.
run.identity: worker_instance_id/run_id under work_item_id; add campaign_id/phase_id/gate_id as routing metadata when useful.
run.rule: One mission, one durable return, then terminal state; retries create new runs rather than mutating history.

identity_model.design_reason: Keep lifecycle, phase, gate result and depth policy orthogonal so a campaign does not become an unreadable single mega-enum.

phase_gate_state_machine.on_fail: Recover missing durable state; ask human only if the missing input is a real identity/consent boundary.
Continue reconstruction or architecture exploration. In EXHAUSTIVE mode freeze the meaningful map before deepening it.

pass_when: required archaeology/research/context questions answered or bounded
known uncertainty is below phase-specific threshold
phase_gate_state_machine.on_fail: Launch more read-only scouts/context retrieval/challengers rather than forcing premature implementation.
Repair plan/decomposition; do not launch workers from conversational intent alone.

pass_when: all Work Items required for the current execution wave are terminal or explicitly bounded
no required missing launch is being mistaken for completion
phase_gate_state_machine.on_fail: Continue ready independent work; surface only the smallest current human launch action if platform spawning is the actual boundary.

follow-up jobs generated for unresolved repairable gaps
phase_gate_state_machine.on_fail: Return to EXPLORE/PREPARE/EXECUTE for targeted follow-up instead of averaging conflicting worker opinions.

phase_gate_state_machine.on_fail: Compile repair jobs and loop to PREPARE/EXECUTE; do not close on prose or source-commit success alone.

phase_gate_state_machine.on_fail: Persist the missing durable state before allowing transcript deletion.

transition_rules: Gate evaluation is evidence-driven and declarative; a chat message, newest commit, worker DONE or version number does not pass a gate by itself.
Any repairable gate failure loops to the earliest phase that can repair it; do not restart the campaign from zero.
New evidence that invalidates the map may send the campaign back to MAP/PREPARE while preserving prior evidence and checkpoints.
WAITING_HUMAN is only for real identity/consent/physical/external/high-risk boundaries, not normal scheduling.
A human '.'/Continue command resyncs EPOCH and resumes from the last valid campaign checkpoint/gate. It never means approval, acceptance, promotion or gate bypass.
campaign_controller_responsibilities: Load campaign head + current EPOCH + relevant compiled state and derive the smallest current control picture.
Evaluate current gate predicates from durable evidence and advance automatically when satisfied and no human boundary exists.
Invoke Planner/Compiler to turn the current campaign map into dependency-aware prepared Work Items; never define ad hoc worker prompts as the durable plan.
Maintain ready/running/returned/unconsumed/boundary projections from independent job/run/return records rather than a hand-edited central status.
Choose adaptive depth based on uncertainty, novelty, authority risk, rollback difficulty, regression surface, conflict count and evidence gaps.
Schedule critics/challengers before high-risk gates, when returns conflict, after major material implementation, and before close when falsification risk warrants it.
Checkpoint at meaningful transitions and before/after risky execution or human boundaries.
Trigger Steward/Merger integration when enough returns exist; do not let workers self-promote candidates.
Compile the smallest next human action only when platform/consent boundaries make human action unavoidable.
Remain idempotent/convergent: the same durable campaign state should derive the same next action unless EPOCH/evidence changed.

adaptive_depth.FAST: Low-risk, reversible, well-known work: minimal sufficient reconstruction, single execution path, targeted tests.
adaptive_depth.DEEP: Architecture/meaningful uncertainty: context -> complete meaningful map -> development -> execution -> critique -> repair.
adaptive_depth.EXHAUSTIVE: High-stakes or broad-coverage work: freeze the meaningful coverage map, fan out independent exploration/critics, close every mapped item or record explicit boundary before convergence.
adaptive_depth.CONTINUE: Resume an existing campaign from its canonical checkpoint/head after EPOCH refresh; do not regenerate settled context.
adaptive_depth.historical_4x_mapping: Candidate compatibility mapping only: treat 4X as an adaptive escalation/fan-out policy that increases independent passes/critics/context breadth when risk or uncertainty warrants it, not as a mandatory fixed number of chats. Exact historical R38 mechanics were not directly reopened in this scout.

parallel_worker_scheduling_rules: Compute a dependency DAG and launch the ready set, not an arbitrary linear queue.
Parallelize read-only archaeology/research/critique aggressively; conceptual overlap is allowed and useful.
Write-capable jobs may run concurrently only with disjoint scopes, isolated candidate branches/artifacts, or explicit reconciliation ownership.
A live HARD_WRITE_COLLISION blocks only the overlapping writers; unrelated jobs continue.
Prepared job with no run object is NOT_LAUNCHED, never active or complete.
Parent/controller need not idle for a whole batch: integrate high-value partial returns when useful, while preserving a final convergence gate.
Do not launch duplicate jobs solely because a worker is slow; retry/stale/supersession policy belongs to the execution-fabric owner and must preserve run lineage.

Current platform limitation may require the human to open a fresh chat and paste a tiny launch command. Controller owns the launch backlog/state so this remains a mechanical boundary, not mental scheduling.
Do not hard-code one universal concurrency number; bound fan-out by scope independence, context cost, write collisions and available platform capacity.

checkpoint_reincarnation_semantics.principle: Campaign has one canonical mutable head pointer plus immutable historical checkpoints. Latest timestamp is not authority.
reincarnation_algorithm: Resolve Chat Object and active campaign_id(s).
Load canonical campaign head/checkpoint, not newest-looking file.
Read current EPOCH and reload only affected method/context/work/authority refs when changed.
Re-derive exact job/run/return state; open runs remain open/stale candidates rather than being silently cancelled.
Re-evaluate the current gate from present evidence.
Continue automatically if safe; otherwise surface only a real boundary.
checkpoint_reincarnation_semantics.rollback_rule: Rolling back campaign/control state does not itself roll back product Current or Served. Product rollback remains under the corresponding owner/authority chain.
checkpoint_reincarnation_semantics.dot_compatibility: WAITING_DOT should not be a default campaign scheduler state. Retain it only as an optional human-paced/compatibility pause: '.' performs resync + CONTINUE from checkpoint and cannot satisfy a failed gate.

historical_compatibility_map.DAY_WORK: Candidate: treat as a bounded execution/session envelope generated by a campaign phase (today's ready work, checks, returns), never as campaign identity or durable memory. Exact historical R29 rules need targeted archaeology before formal reuse.
historical_compatibility_map.4X: Candidate: map to adaptive depth/fan-out escalation inside the controller, not a parallel authority or fixed workflow. Exact historical mechanics need targeted archaeology.
historical_compatibility_map.fresh_chat_epoch: Reuse existing EPOCH-first reincarnation: checkpoint carries epoch_seen, successor compares current EPOCH, reloads only changed relevant state, then re-evaluates gate.
historical_compatibility_map.WAITING_DOT: Compatibility pause only; dot means resume from last valid durable gate after freshness check, never human approval.
historical_compatibility_map.Campaign_Metabolism: Candidate umbrella name for the controller loop: observe -> derive -> evaluate gate -> plan/schedule -> consume returns -> challenge/repair -> checkpoint -> advance/escalate.

reuse_unchanged_or_extend.role: Operational seat that points to active campaigns and reincarnates them; do not embed all campaign state in FOCUS.
Cheap freshness trigger for controller/reincarnation; not campaign authority.
Derived worker/collision/dependency nervous system; extend metadata with campaign_id/phase_id/gate_id where useful.
Execution fabric under Campaign. Keep independent run state and parent-derived summaries.
Compile campaign map + dependencies + owner/write scopes + Working Set into prepared jobs. Campaign Controller decides when planning is needed; Planner decides decomposition.
Single canonical integration authority for returns and conflict resolution.
Compile phase/job context and evidence without flooding every successor.
Remain external product authority; campaign only references/checks them.
Reuse barrier/snapshot/digest/idempotence concepts for phase inputs/gates where race-free context freezing matters.
Recover campaign head + current gate/run state after chat loss.
Package/projection of campaign state for portability; must not become the campaign itself.
